question: Based on Landsat B10 thermal infrared data of Lake Ontario (2022-12-16), calculate the mean surface water temperature in Celsius.
final_answer_preview:
The mean surface water temperature calculated from the Landsat B10 thermal infrared data for Lake Ontario on 2022-12-16 is **-16.29°C**.

This value represents the brightness temperature derived directly from the thermal band data. Note that Landsat thermal bands typically provide brightness temperature in Kelvin, which requires conversion to Celsius. If more accurate surface temperature is needed, additional atmospheric and emissivity corrections would be required.
